shots.caption: Takeoff from Runway 09 on Pulau Karang — Nusa-1 on the runway, rings ahead, HUD lit
Ring 4 of 8 over the archipelago — islands, volcanic peaks, sun glitter on the sea
Final approach to Runway 27 on Pulau Bintang — all 8 rings flown, gear down for landing
Cockpit view — six-pack instruments (attitude, airspeed, altitude, heading, throttle, rings) over the islands
